CODE
Art. 2.3.47. 
Termination of compensation accounts 
Compensation owed by the spouse to the joint estate and compensation owed by the joint estate to the spouse are cancelled up to the lower amount.
 If both spouses are creditors or debtors of rewards, their respective claims and debts are cancelled up to the lowest amount.
 Only the spouse whose claim or debt is greater remains creditor or debtor of a reward equal to the difference between the respective claims or debts.
